search.query: | mstats avg("disk.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | 1=1 | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("disk.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*temperature*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("disk.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*percentage_used*","*available_spare*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("disk.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*realloc_raw*","*unc_raw*","*crc_raw*","*offline_unc_raw*","*ud_unc_raw*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("disk.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*power_on_hours*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
